hypothesis: Open interest expansion confirms new risk-taking in both directions at a price-channel break, and yields stronger continuation than an unfiltered break or a break during open interest contraction.
signal_definition: Observe each UTC hour. The price input is the perpetual candle close known at t-5 minutes. Breakout is at least 20 bps above the maximum or at least the reciprocal buffer below the minimum of the preceding 168 hourly observations. Trigger on the first hour of a nonzero directional price edge. Read exact OI quantity at t-15min and at t-24h-15min; both finite and positive are required for all three accounts. Candidate requires at least 3% OI expansion, opposite ablation requires at least 3% contraction, and Price uses neither threshold. Missing and zero observations stay ineligible. Hold signal for up to 96 hours from the edge, until price reverses past the initial channel level by 1%, or until the account's terminal hour. New edges during an active signal do not extend or flip that signal. Reset signal state at each window.
execution: At most two targets, oldest valid signal wins, alphabetical tie-break, each target is 48% of NAV, no trade if missing data. Use existing exact funding clock calendar replay; when the target set changes, rebalance at the next 5m transaction close with adverse slippage and capacity. Allow the engine's existing delayed reversals and rebalances. Stop at 10% adverse price and halt at 35% 5m close-based account drawdown with delayed exits. Begin volume-constrained terminal exits one hour before cutoff.
comparison: Run 2024 first, from cash. At both costs require net return positive and greater than both controls, positive return in both halves, no halt, 35% or lower maximum drawdown, at least 35 closed lifecycles across at least 12 entry weeks, and no open terminal inventory. Require 25% net annualized at 15bps as upside hurdle. Only after passing, run the later cash-reset window under identical policy and gates. For that window download checksummed OI archives only for exact price-edge decision and 24h predecessor dates. Two historical cohorts with a fixed incumbent universe; not forward evidence.
